amendments_considered.what_changed: First Amendment (Mar 21, 2023): replaced the Appriss-relative step-down with 4.25x for quarters ending ~Dec 31, 2022 through ~Dec 31, 2023 and 3.75x from ~Mar 31, 2024; Material Acquisition 0.50x step-up disregarded through Dec 31, 2023; added EBITDA clause (xi) integration costs capped at $100,000,000; Consolidated Funded Debt now excludes Permitted Receivables Financing Debt.
Second Amendment (May 24, 2024): conformed copy shows Section 8.01 levels unchanged (4.25x through ~Dec 31, 2023; 3.75x thereafter). Purpose not determined; no covenant level change found.

Third Amendment (May 27, 2025): conformed copy shows Section 8.01 and Leverage Ratio/Consolidated Funded Debt/Consolidated EBITDA definitions unchanged vs Second Amendment conformed copy (whitespace-normalized compare). Used as definitions source.
Fourth Amendment (Apr 23, 2026): adds 2026 incremental and 2029 revolving lenders; Section 8.01 text in conformed copy still 4.25x/3.75x. Not fully diffed for definition changes.

draft_notes: Original-agreement thresholds are Appriss-relative; Appriss Closing Date taken as Oct 1, 2021 from the FY2021 10-K (evidence.appriss_closing_date), not from the agreement. Verify the quarter mapping: 3.75x only for Q3 2021, 4.25x Q4 2021-Q3 2022.

Original schedule's 4.00x (5th-6th FQ after Appriss close = Dec 31, 2022 and Mar 31, 2023) and 3.75x (7th FQ onward) were superseded by the First Amendment before/at those test dates and are omitted; verifier may prefer to include them.
Optional 0.50x Material Acquisition step-up (max 4.75x) omitted per README (base schedule only).
Numerator is Consolidated Funded Debt minus Cash Netting Amount (cash over $175,000,000, capped at 37.5% of Consolidated EBITDA); recorded via numerator_net_of and the Cash Netting Amount term.

Consolidated Funded Debt children are clause descriptions of the Debt definition (clauses (a),(b),(f),(g),(h),(i),(j),(l)); (i) counted only to the extent then due and owing, (j) only drawn and unreimbursed.
Definitions quoted from the Third Amendment conformed copy (in force for 2025); the original 2021 agreement lacked EBITDA clause (xi) and had a different Consolidated Funded Debt clause list.
